title: review.v0
description: Independent review of an edit. A reviewer is never the executor repeating its own success claim, so reviewer_id and executor_id must differ. Release always passes the human gate.

accepted.description: Only a WEAK finding may be accepted. FAIL and CRITICAL can never be dispositioned away.

findings.description: Every dimension is judged exactly once. Cardinality is fixed at the number of reviewer dimensions, and the validator additionally enforces set equality so a repeated dimension cannot satisfy the count.

x-derived.verdict_rule: any CRITICAL -> REJECT; any non-accepted FAIL or WEAK -> NEEDS_REPAIR; otherwise PRODUCTION_READY
x-derived.verdict_precondition: every reviewer dimension judged exactly once; an incomplete review is a contract rejection, not a partial release
x-derived.repair_default: targeted to the smallest affected range; regenerating the entire video is refused
